__m.name: Timeskip
__m.lore: Chronological anomalies sometimes split themselves open, with no rhyme or reason. Catch one at the right time, and you'll find yourself somewhen else.

__m.name: Gleam
__m.lore: History measures empires; what are you, if not but a subtle flicker-masked within the brilliance of generations past?

__m.name: Blue Mask
__m.lore: The Blue Mask's physical traits are equal to that of paper, but the mystical properties enhance the wearers personal skills tenfold. The mask is thought to originate from an ancient Dernel tribe.

__m.name: Leo
__m.lore: This thick skinned jacket, imbued with the courage of a thousand lion hearts, will grant the user massive protection from all who target them.

__m.name: Adamantite
__m.lore: Adamantite is a soft metal often added to exotic medicine to increase one's health, but a revolutionary blacksmith on Black Road, created a chestplate with an Adamantite alloy, which is advertised to bolster the users endurance.

__m.name: Cardiac Arrest
__m.lore: ...As the heart fails, adrenaline pumps through the body in an attempt to provide energy and keep the victim alive, but medical action must be taken to ensure survival. -Excerpt from Aldorei Medical Tomes, Vol. 6

__m.name: The Jingling Jester
__m.lore: Jingle jangle, while shaking your bells. Jingle jangle come the pockets of cash... Catch the trickster, send them to hell," their money is gone and off you've dashed!

__m.name: Cloak of Luminosity
__m.quest: Realm of Light III - A Headless History

__m.name: Babel
__m.lore: All legends must one day fall, but their legacy shall be remembered forevermore.  These memories exist in the hearts of all,  and pave the path forward in hopes to create a world where all may find peace,  however rocky that path may be.

__m.name: Sodeta Boots
__m.lore: These boots were standard issue to members of the prestigious, and now disbanded, Sodeta Guild, and given as a gift to the owners of Delnar Mansion one day.

__m.name: Static Cling
__m.lore: Forged in a hidden workshop, these boots were imbued with earthen quartz and bound lightning. Their wearer crackles with static energy, amplifying every strike. Many have chased this power, only to find themselves uprooted by its shocking embrace.

__m.name: Mazeweaver
__m.lore: The strong can hammer foe and nature alike into submission, waging war with indiscriminate force. The truly powerful pit them against each other on a whim, weaving stone and verdure into an elaborate web of attrition that beats with the heart of an entire world. What is an enemy compared to all the might of the Earth?

__m.name: Abysso Galoshes
__m.lore: Rumored to be crafted from a Dernic stone, these sinister boots radiate extremely powerful dark energy. They have absorbed the power of the raging seas in their time locked in Sarnfic.

__m.name: Summa
__m.lore: An auxiliary power core of the powerful TERA-4M Mining robot line. It controls the robots by giving the bearer a compulsion to break new grounds and progress further without heed.

__m.name: Unspeakable
__m.lore: The wielders of this cursed glassen bauble are rendered mute. The effect is reversed after the item is removed, but the longer it is worn, the longer the curse remains.

__m.name: Diamond Static Bracelet
__m.lore: The heavy shocks coming from this perfected bracelet would be lethal under normal circumstances, but the only thing its wearer senses is the enhancement of power.
